report.answer: PyYAML SafeLoader (YAML 1.1) exposes 40 meaning-changing coercions across 263 YAML config files on this worktree. Catalog input .github/workflows/quality.yml is present; its unquoted `on:` key loads as bool True (3 hazard row(s) in that file). Hazard classes: {"empty-to-null": 15, "version-like-float": 6, "yaml11-bool-key": 19}. No live NO/OFF/ON/YES *value* (country-code class) was found; the live hits are bool mapping keys (`on:`), empty-to-null, and trailing-zero dotted scalars (2.00/20.00). Planted control fired; quoted twin was silent. SUCCESS:TST-0059

inline_matrix_fixture.note: In-code fixture, not a repo config file. Live yaml.safe_load call site exposed to YAML 1.1 key coercion of `on:`.

report.question_or_target: YAML config readers must not coerce NO/OFF/ON/YES to booleans, bare version-like scalars to floats, or empty to null in a way that changes meaning. A country code NO becoming False is the canonical instance. Which config keys are exposed to this?
